the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

## Thank you for visiting Australian Dental Clinic

**Australian Dental Clinic** was established in 2006, located right center of **Hanoi** with five
minutes walk from Sword Lake. Proudly we are the first local dental clinic taking care of
expatriates and foreign tourists in **Hanoi.**

Expanding its footprint, the clinic recently inaugurated a new branch in **Da Nang**, extending its
exceptional services to residents and visitors alike. This expansion underscores the clinic's
dedication to delivering high-quality dental solutions across **Vietnam**.

Our philosophy is simple. We try to provide quality dental care for you and your family in a happy,
professional, and caring environment.

Our aim is to care for you as a person and give you a healthy, beautiful smile in comfortable
surroundings. We endeavor to dispel the myth that a visit to the dentist should be an uncomfortable
experience. In striving for this, we have developed a warm, welcoming facility, incorporating the
latest advancements in dental technology, and most importantly…established a team of highly skilled,
motivated, and caring professionals to provide you with the best dental care. It is important to us
that you feel welcomed and comfortable during each visit and that you go with a smile…

Our Dentists have extensive experience in providing quality treatments, including: Whitening,
Veneers, Crowns & Bridges, White Fillings, Root Canal, Implant, Straighter Teeth, Orthodontics,
Braces, and Cosmetic Dentistry.

# Partnering to Deliver Better Patient Care.

The innovative companies that are part of Envista help dental professionals deliver the best
possible patient care, every step of the way. We know that dental professionals do more than create
healthy, beautiful smiles—they create confidence. To achieve their goals, they need a champion. At
Envista, we're uniquely positioned to be this champion.

[ About us ][16]

### 2025 Annual Report

New Report

##### Just Released: Our 2025 Annual Report.

[**Learn more**][17]

Anchored by Envista’s value of Continuous Improvement, the Envista Business System (EBS) is our
foundation for success.

# Who We Are

Envista is a global family of more than 30 trusted dental brands, united by a shared purpose: to
partner with professionals to improve lives. Envista helps its partners deliver the best possible
patient care through industry-leading products, solutions, and technology.

[ Watch video ][18] [ More about us ][19]

### Transforming the Dental Industry

The Envista portfolio of brands is dedicated to supporting, expanding, and improving how dental
professionals care for their patients. Focused on innovation and the future of the digital
landscape, we provide quality products and solutions for the dental office and beyond.

[ Learn more about Envista ][20]

### Side by Side

From digital consultation and modeling tools to superior equipment and surgical instruments, Envista
companies support dental professionals at every patient interaction, with increasingly integrated
digital workflows. Our comprehensive training and education programs offer career-spanning
professional growth.

[ Explore our businesses ][21]

## Specialty Products & Technologies

Envista's Specialty Products & Technologies division develops and manufactures a wide variety of
dental products, including dental implant systems, prosthetics, clear aligners, bracket and wires,
orthodontic and lab products, and the technology to match.

**[Learn more][22]**

## Equipment & Consumables

Envista's Equipment & Consumables segment develops and manufactures dental equipment and consumable
supplies used in dental offices, including digital imaging systems, dental practice equipment,
endodontic systems, restorative and impression materials, bonding agents and cements, and infection
prevention products.

**[Learn more][29]**

Creating confidence is no small business. With deep industry roots and decades of world-class
experience, the people behind Envista know this well. Our companies help dental professionals
deliver the best possible patient care through industry-leading products, solutions, and technology.

عالج مشاكل أسنانك في مكان واحد

[Toot Canal Therapy]

علاج قناة الجذر: إجراء يُنقذ الأسنان التالفة أو المصابة بعدوى، ويحافظ على سلامة وصحة الفم

## المركز الأوروبي لطب وزراعة الأسنان

المركز الأوروبي لطب الأسنان هو وجهتك الأولى وخيارك الآمن للحصول على الرعاية السنية الشاملة بخبرة 30 عاماً
بوجود فريقنا المتميز من أطباء الأسنان الاحترافيين، والمتخصصين ذوي الخبرة العاملين وفق المعايير
الأوروبية بإدارة الدكتور مهند الكسواني لتقديم تجربة طبية فريدة في بيئة صحية ومريحة على مستوى عالي من
التعقيم، تجدون كل ما يلزم من التقنيات المتطورة وأحدث الأجهزة العالمية في مجال طب الأسنان لعلاج جميع
الحالات والفئات العمرية وخاصة الحالات الحرجة، من خلال خدماتنا السنية الاستثنائية.
* كافة الخدمات السنية الشاملة
* خبرة في زراعة الأسنان
* علاج متخصص للشخير وانقطاع التنفس أثناء النوم
* تقنيات التشخيص الرقمي المتقدمة
* الالتزام بأعلى مستويات التعقيم لسلامة المرضى
* أجهزة طبية حديثة ومتطورة

# iLABOT - A Brand By ACMAS Technologies INC.

iLabot is newly established laboratory equipment brand in Indian market. Under this brand name we
make and supply various laboratory and scientific equipment used in universities & academic areas,
food laboratories, pharma and biotech laboratories, research centers and other fields – prices are
reasonable and performance is unmatched. Our parent organization [**Acmas Technologies** ][17]has
been manufacturing Autoclaves and all other scientific instruments for over 25 years.


Acmas Technologies Inc. started as an Autoclave manufacturing company and operated under Obromax
brand about 4 decades ago. Moving ahead with the times, we added iLabot as our brand as a part of
our vision to expand and offer all types of Medical, Research, Scientific and Micro-biological
equipment with more than 50 equipment on offer ranging from **[horizontal autoclave][18], [co2
incubator][19], [fume hoods][20], [vertical autoclave][21]** to name a few. We cater to labs,
hospitals, pharmaceuticals, textiles, electrolyte testing, and light industries. Our products
promise accurate results, lasting reliability, and user-friendly operation. Whether you’re setting
up a new lab or upgrading equipment, we have the cost-effective solutions for you. With our own
manufacturing units, we engineer highly customized equipment to suit the needs of our customers.

# Welcome to Mediclave

MediClave Industries, a premier division of Shiv Group, has been a trusted partner for hospitals and
laboratories for over a decade. We have strategically expanded to serve pharmaceutical giants both
in India and abroad. Our diverse product range includes advanced sterilizers such as steam,
steam-air mixture, dry heat, rubber bung processors, and terminal sterilizers as well as water
systems such as Water for Injection (WFI) systems with capacities from 100 to 10,000 litres per
hour, pure steam generation systems and Injectable liquid & Ointment manufacturing plants, CIP/SIP
systems. Additionally, we offer superheated water spray sterilizers for the dairy industries.
MediClave is dedicated to meet highest standards on time.

## Frequently Asked Questions

##### What does Mediclave Industries manufacture?

Mediclave Industries manufactures pharmaceutical sterilization equipment, autoclaves, WFI systems,
pure steam generators, and process equipment for sterile manufacturing applications.

##### Are you a sterilization equipment manufacturer in Ahmedabad?

Yes, Mediclave Industries is a sterilization equipment manufacturer based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat,
India, serving pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

##### What types of sterilizers do you offer?

We offer steam sterilizers, dry heat sterilizers, steam-air mixture sterilizers, and terminal
sterilization systems for pharmaceutical applications.

## Our Story

### [Evolving with DJs since 1994]

For over 30 years, we've driven the evolution of DJ technology to expand creativity for artists
worldwide. Today, AlphaTheta draws on the DNA of Pioneer and Pioneer DJ, continuing our legacy of
innovation and engineering excellence.

In 1994, Pioneer launched the CDJ-500 – the world's first flat-top CD player with a turntable feel.
Combining digital precision with analog touch, it revolutionized DJing and marked the start of our
DJ business.

[1994][CDJ-500][145]

### [Defining the global club standard: CDJ & DJM series]

The CDJ and DJM series have defined the global club standard of DJ equipment for decades.In 2006,
the CDJ-1000MK3 achieved intuitive CD scratching through its exceptional jog wheel control, while
the DJM-800 introduced high-quality digital sound processing and more creative effects.Together,
they became the go-to setup for clubs around the world – shaping the experience of modern dance
music.

[CDJ-1000MK3][146]
[2006][DJM-800][147]

### [Expanding creative choices: DDJ & XDJ series]

As DJ culture evolved, so did we.In 2012, the DDJ-SX changed the game for controller DJs – combining
PC power and Serato software for a professional experience. In 2015, the XDJ-RX delivered
club-quality performance as a compact all-in-one device capable of playing tracks managed in
rekordbox directly from a USB drive.Both series continue to evolve – empowering DJs with new ways to
perform and express their creativity.

[2012][DDJ-SX][148]
[2015][XDJ-RX][149]

### [The next chapter: AlphaTheta]

In 2024, we launched our brand, AlphaTheta, to drive innovation.The rotary mixer, euphonia, delivers
an immersive sound that combines warmth and clarity, while the next-generation DJ player, the
CDJ-3000X, opens new horizons for professionals.From Pioneer to Pioneer DJ, and now to AlphaTheta,
our DNA of innovation and quality lives on.

[2024][euphonia][150]
[2025][CDJ-3000X][151]

## Thank you for visiting Australian Dental Clinic

**Australian Dental Clinic** was established in 2006, located right center of **Hanoi** with five
minutes walk from Sword Lake. Proudly we are the first local dental clinic taking care of
expatriates and foreign tourists in **Hanoi.**

Expanding its footprint, the clinic recently inaugurated a new branch in **Da Nang**, extending its
exceptional services to residents and visitors alike. This expansion underscores the clinic's
dedication to delivering high-quality dental solutions across **Vietnam**.

Our philosophy is simple. We try to provide quality dental care for you and your family in a happy,
professional, and caring environment.

Our aim is to care for you as a person and give you a healthy, beautiful smile in comfortable
surroundings. We endeavor to dispel the myth that a visit to the dentist should be an uncomfortable
experience. In striving for this, we have developed a warm, welcoming facility, incorporating the
latest advancements in dental technology, and most importantly…established a team of highly skilled,
motivated, and caring professionals to provide you with the best dental care. It is important to us
that you feel welcomed and comfortable during each visit and that you go with a smile…

Our Dentists have extensive experience in providing quality treatments, including: Whitening,
Veneers, Crowns & Bridges, White Fillings, Root Canal, Implant, Straighter Teeth, Orthodontics,
Braces, and Cosmetic Dentistry.

# Partnering to Deliver Better Patient Care.

The innovative companies that are part of Envista help dental professionals deliver the best
possible patient care, every step of the way. We know that dental professionals do more than create
healthy, beautiful smiles—they create confidence. To achieve their goals, they need a champion. At
Envista, we're uniquely positioned to be this champion.

[ About us ][16]

### 2025 Annual Report

New Report

##### Just Released: Our 2025 Annual Report.

[**Learn more**][17]

Anchored by Envista’s value of Continuous Improvement, the Envista Business System (EBS) is our
foundation for success.

# Who We Are

Envista is a global family of more than 30 trusted dental brands, united by a shared purpose: to
partner with professionals to improve lives. Envista helps its partners deliver the best possible
patient care through industry-leading products, solutions, and technology.

[ Watch video ][18] [ More about us ][19]

### Transforming the Dental Industry

The Envista portfolio of brands is dedicated to supporting, expanding, and improving how dental
professionals care for their patients. Focused on innovation and the future of the digital
landscape, we provide quality products and solutions for the dental office and beyond.

[ Learn more about Envista ][20]

### Side by Side

From digital consultation and modeling tools to superior equipment and surgical instruments, Envista
companies support dental professionals at every patient interaction, with increasingly integrated
digital workflows. Our comprehensive training and education programs offer career-spanning
professional growth.

[ Explore our businesses ][21]

## Specialty Products & Technologies

Envista's Specialty Products & Technologies division develops and manufactures a wide variety of
dental products, including dental implant systems, prosthetics, clear aligners, bracket and wires,
orthodontic and lab products, and the technology to match.

**[Learn more][22]**

## Equipment & Consumables

Envista's Equipment & Consumables segment develops and manufactures dental equipment and consumable
supplies used in dental offices, including digital imaging systems, dental practice equipment,
endodontic systems, restorative and impression materials, bonding agents and cements, and infection
prevention products.

**[Learn more][29]**

Creating confidence is no small business. With deep industry roots and decades of world-class

deliver the best possible patient care through industry-leading products, solutions, and technology.

## المركز الأوروبي لطب وزراعة الأسنان

المركز الأوروبي لطب الأسنان هو وجهتك الأولى وخيارك الآمن للحصول على الرعاية السنية الشاملة بخبرة 30 عاماً
بوجود فريقنا المتميز من أطباء الأسنان الاحترافيين، والمتخصصين ذوي الخبرة العاملين وفق المعايير
الأوروبية بإدارة الدكتور مهند الكسواني لتقديم تجربة طبية فريدة في بيئة صحية ومريحة على مستوى عالي من
التعقيم، تجدون كل ما يلزم من التقنيات المتطورة وأحدث الأجهزة العالمية في مجال طب الأسنان لعلاج جميع
الحالات والفئات العمرية وخاصة الحالات الحرجة، من خلال خدماتنا السنية الاستثنائية.
* كافة الخدمات السنية الشاملة
* خبرة في زراعة الأسنان
* علاج متخصص للشخير وانقطاع التنفس أثناء النوم
* تقنيات التشخيص الرقمي المتقدمة
* الالتزام بأعلى مستويات التعقيم لسلامة المرضى
* أجهزة طبية حديثة ومتطورة

# iLABOT - A Brand By ACMAS Technologies INC.

iLabot is newly established laboratory equipment brand in Indian market. Under this brand name we
make and supply various laboratory and scientific equipment used in universities & academic areas,
food laboratories, pharma and biotech laboratories, research centers and other fields – prices are
reasonable and performance is unmatched. Our parent organization [**Acmas Technologies** ][17]has
been manufacturing Autoclaves and all other scientific instruments for over 25 years.


Acmas Technologies Inc. started as an Autoclave manufacturing company and operated under Obromax
brand about 4 decades ago. Moving ahead with the times, we added iLabot as our brand as a part of
our vision to expand and offer all types of Medical, Research, Scientific and Micro-biological
equipment with more than 50 equipment on offer ranging from **[horizontal autoclave][18], [co2
incubator][19], [fume hoods][20], [vertical autoclave][21]** to name a few. We cater to labs,
hospitals, pharmaceuticals, textiles, electrolyte testing, and light industries. Our products
promise accurate results, lasting reliability, and user-friendly operation. Whether you’re setting
up a new lab or upgrading equipment, we have the cost-effective solutions for you. With our own
manufacturing units, we engineer highly customized equipment to suit the needs of our customers.

# Welcome to Mediclave

MediClave Industries, a premier division of Shiv Group, has been a trusted partner for hospitals and
laboratories for over a decade. We have strategically expanded to serve pharmaceutical giants both
in India and abroad. Our diverse product range includes advanced sterilizers such as steam,
steam-air mixture, dry heat, rubber bung processors, and terminal sterilizers as well as water
systems such as Water for Injection (WFI) systems with capacities from 100 to 10,000 litres per
hour, pure steam generation systems and Injectable liquid & Ointment manufacturing plants, CIP/SIP
systems. Additionally, we offer superheated water spray sterilizers for the dairy industries.
MediClave is dedicated to meet highest standards on time.

## Frequently Asked Questions

##### What does Mediclave Industries manufacture?

Mediclave Industries manufactures pharmaceutical sterilization equipment, autoclaves, WFI systems,
pure steam generators, and process equipment for sterile manufacturing applications.

##### Are you a sterilization equipment manufacturer in Ahmedabad?

Yes, Mediclave Industries is a sterilization equipment manufacturer based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat,
India, serving pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

##### What types of sterilizers do you offer?

We offer steam sterilizers, dry heat sterilizers, steam-air mixture sterilizers, and terminal

## Our Story

### [Evolving with DJs since 1994]

For over 30 years, we've driven the evolution of DJ technology to expand creativity for artists
worldwide. Today, AlphaTheta draws on the DNA of Pioneer and Pioneer DJ, continuing our legacy of
innovation and engineering excellence.

In 1994, Pioneer launched the CDJ-500 – the world's first flat-top CD player with a turntable feel.
Combining digital precision with analog touch, it revolutionized DJing and marked the start of our
DJ business.

[1994][CDJ-500][145]

### [Defining the global club standard: CDJ & DJM series]

The CDJ and DJM series have defined the global club standard of DJ equipment for decades.In 2006,
the CDJ-1000MK3 achieved intuitive CD scratching through its exceptional jog wheel control, while
the DJM-800 introduced high-quality digital sound processing and more creative effects.Together,
they became the go-to setup for clubs around the world – shaping the experience of modern dance
music.

[CDJ-1000MK3][146]
[2006][DJM-800][147]

### [Expanding creative choices: DDJ & XDJ series]

As DJ culture evolved, so did we.In 2012, the DDJ-SX changed the game for controller DJs – combining
PC power and Serato software for a professional experience. In 2015, the XDJ-RX delivered
club-quality performance as a compact all-in-one device capable of playing tracks managed in
rekordbox directly from a USB drive.Both series continue to evolve – empowering DJs with new ways to
perform and express their creativity.

[2012][DDJ-SX][148]
[2015][XDJ-RX][149]

### [The next chapter: AlphaTheta]

In 2024, we launched our brand, AlphaTheta, to drive innovation.The rotary mixer, euphonia, delivers
an immersive sound that combines warmth and clarity, while the next-generation DJ player, the
CDJ-3000X, opens new horizons for professionals.From Pioneer to Pioneer DJ, and now to AlphaTheta,
our DNA of innovation and quality lives on.

[2024][euphonia][150]
[2025][CDJ-3000X][151]
